cards.answer: Annie is a mage and support who deals magic damage with fire spells and Tibbers. She can stun enemies and shield herself or an allied champion.
cards.counterplay: Respect her ready stun and avoid grouping where her area spells can hit several allies.

cards.answer: Annie builds up to four Pyromania stacks by hitting an enemy with Q or casting her other abilities. At full stacks, the next Q, W or R to land consumes the stacks to stun enemies hit. Her stun starts ready at game start and after respawning.
cards.counterplay: Watch her stack counter and keep your distance when her stun is ready.

cards.answer: Annie fires a targeted fireball that deals magic damage to an enemy. Killing the target refunds its mana cost and reduces its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Keep outside her targeting range when her stun is ready.

If this kills the target, Disintegrate's cooldown is reduced by 50% and its mana cost is refunded.

facts.claim: Killing the target refunds its mana cost and reduces its cooldown.

cards.priority_reason: A targeted spell can deliver her ready stun.
uncertainties: The refund and cooldown reduction also apply if the target is dead when the missile arrives.
Target-invalidating events during casting can cancel Q without spending mana or starting its cooldown.

cards.answer: Annie releases fire in a chosen direction, dealing magic damage to enemies hit in a cone.
cards.counterplay: Spread out and stay clear of her cone, especially when her stun is ready.

citations.quote: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.

facts.claim: Annie releases fire in a chosen direction, dealing magic damage to enemies hit in a cone.

cards.priority_reason: The cone can deliver her stun to multiple enemies.
uncertainties: Targets behind Annie can be hit if their radius intersects the cone.
The cone originates from Annie's position at the end of casting.

cards.answer: Annie shields herself or a target allied champion and grants a temporary burst of movement speed; Tibbers also receives these effects. While the shield is active, eligible enemies damaging it with attacks or spells take magic damage, once per enemy per cast for each shield.
cards.counterplay: Account for the shield's speed burst when chasing. Avoid unnecessary hits into the active shield.

cards.priority_reason: The shield and speed burst can protect an ally or help Annie approach.

cards.answer: Annie summons Tibbers at a target location, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. Tibbers remains to attack and burn nearby enemies with magic damage; recast R to direct him while he is alive.
cards.counterplay: Spread out to limit the summon's area hit. Move away from Tibbers to avoid his nearby burn.
